task: Restore the Air-Gap E2E (#217): pin the runner to ubuntu-24.04 (ubuntu-26.04 breaks kind image load for every fs) and make the ext4 host-tool step work on linux-azure-7.0 kernels, which no longer publish linux-modules-extra (quota_tree/quota_v2 moved to base linux-modules).

events.summary: Changed: e2e-airgap job runs-on (ubuntu-latest -> ubuntu-24.04) with a D1 comment; the ext4 branch of Install Host Tools now installs linux-modules-extra-$(uname -r) only when `modinfo quota_tree`/`quota_v2` fails; one sentence added to the AGENTS.md ext4 kernel-module gotcha. Not touched: scripts/e2e (setup-fs-nfs.sh already tolerates a failed -extra install), agent code, chart, other workflows.

Reproduced from GitHub Actions history: scheduled E2E run 39221341848 (2026-10-19, runner image ubuntu-24.04) succeeded for xfs/ext4/btrfs; runs 40290897461 (2026-10-26) and 41427109519 (2026-11-02), both on image ubuntu-26.04 with no E2E-related repo change in between, failed all three. 41427109519 log: `ctr: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = content digest sha256:71b0cbca... not found` during `kind load docker-image` (xfs/btrfs); ext4 lacks linux-modules-extra for the 26.04 kernel. ext4 on the pinned image (PR run 41848516963): `E: Unable to locate package linux-modules-extra-7.0.0-1017-azure`; noble-updates Contents-amd64 maps lib/modules/7.0.0-1017-azure/kernel/fs/quota/quota_{tree,v2}.ko.zst to kernel/linux-modules-7.0.0-1017-azure (6.17.0-1022-azure: linux-modules-extra-6.17.0-1022-azure).
Pinned the job to ubuntu-24.04 and guarded the linux-modules-extra install behind a modinfo check so it runs only on kernels that still split the quota modules out.

First push, run 41848516963: xfs and btrfs passed on ubuntu-24.04 (kind image load fixed); ext4 failed on the missing -extra package. The modinfo guard is verified by this PR's next E2E run; claimed passed only for what that run shows (checked before merge). Local: workflow parses as YAML, extracted step passes bash -n.
events.scope: CI-runner level. Proves the existing E2E passes on ubuntu-24.04 with a 7.0-azure kernel; does not make ubuntu-26.04 work (kind image load, #217) and adds no new quota-enforcement evidence beyond the E2E's own assertions.

events.summary: Air-Gap E2E restored on ubuntu-24.04 for xfs/btrfs (run 41848516963) and ext4 via the modinfo guard (this PR's next run); 26.04 kind image load stays in #217.
E2E restored on pinned 24.04; 26.04 support deferred to #217.
